inbox.title: Shared trips
inbox.description: Who wants to share trips with you, and what happened in shared trips.

requests.title: Requests
requests.body: {{name}} (@{{username}}) would like to share trips with you. If you agree, {{name}} can copy trips into your account — each one as your own trip.

notices.title: Notices
notices.left: {{name}} left the shared trip “{{trip}}”. {{name}} keeps their own copy.
notices.created: {{name}} added {{type}} “{{entry}}” to the shared trip. Your copy has been created.
notices.updated: {{name}} changed {{type}} “{{entry}}”. Your copy has been updated.
notices.deleted: {{name}} deleted {{type}} “{{entry}}”. Your copy stays — it is your call.
notices.movedOut: {{name}} took {{type}} “{{entry}}” out of the shared trip. Your copy stays — it is your call.

empty.title: Nothing new
empty.description: Sharing requests and notices about shared trips appear here.

messages.accepted: Agreed — {{name}} can now share trips with you.
messages.undone: Undone — the others see it as your change.

errors.loadFailed: Shared trips could not be loaded.
errors.loadFailedHint: That does not mean there is nothing. Try again.
errors.answerFailed: Your answer could not be saved.
errors.markReadFailed: The notice could not be marked as read.
errors.undoFailed: The change could not be undone.
errors.deleteCopyFailed: Your copy could not be deleted.

settings.title: Share trips
settings.description: Share trips with companions who have an account on this server. Everyone gets their own copy; seat, price, ratings and notes stay private.

consents.title: Consents
consents.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Trips already shared stay as your own trips; changes no longer arrive.

companions.title: Companions
companions.hint: Link a companion to the account that agreed to your request. Then you can share trips with them.
companions.none: No companions yet. They appear when you add them to flights, trips or cruises.
companions.noLinkable: Nobody has agreed to your request yet.

errors.requestFailed: The request could not be sent.
errors.withdrawFailed: The consent could not be withdrawn.
errors.linkFailed: The link could not be saved.

trip.title: Shared
trip.notShared: This trip is not shared with anyone.
trip.noCandidates: Link companions to their account to share trips.
trip.leaveConfirm: Leave the group? Your copy stays as your own trip; the others are notified.
trip.left: You left the group. Your trip stays.
trip.privateHint: Only facts are copied — flights, stays, cruises, rail journeys, rentals and stops. Seat, room, price, ratings and notes stay private.

errors.loadFailed: This trip's sharing could not be loaded.
errors.shareFailed: The trip could not be shared.
errors.leaveFailed: The group could not be left.

trip.bookingTotalsHint: View only — the person named booked and paid; your own share of the price stays private.

errors.userNotFound: There is no account with that username on this server.
errors.duplicate: This request is already pending or accepted.
errors.notPending: This request has already been answered.
errors.consentRequired: This person has not agreed to sharing with you.
errors.alreadyLinked: Another companion is already linked to this account.
errors.notLinked: This person is not linked to an account.
errors.undoStale: Cannot undo any more: your copy has changed since.
errors.undoStaleFields: Cannot undo any more: changed since: {{fields}}.
errors.undoUnavailable: This notice cannot be undone (any more).
